Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/carloan.deepseek.json): 102 of 141 comparisons agree; 32 candidate-unknown records are interview-produced loans with carloan.mixed false and no amount financed (stage12.car.basic, stage12.car.two_loans_cap); the value differences supply allocation amounts with carloan.mixed false (classm.f5695.6: $3,527.00 against $1,037.10) or column (ii) without a Schedule C (classm.carloan.4, as in the Claude log, where that difference alone is representation). The 4 project-unknown records withhold carloan.mixed, which the project asks before any allocation amount. Column (ii) handling is as ruled in the Claude log.
